Miseong, a seemingly ordinary high school student, is also secretly an Insector. But unlike others of his kin, he directs his powers not at humans, but at Insectors instead. Will he maintain control over his abilities and use them for the good of mankind, or will he succumb to the monster within him?

(Source: WEBTOON)

178068.description:
At first, I didn't think much of it... I did it once and didn't get caught. It worked the second time, too. Before I knew it, it had become a habit. I know I shouldn't be doing it! That's right. In order to keep my spot at the top, I'm cheating. But we're suddenly given a pop quiz! I panic so much that I go pale, and my homeroom teacher sends me to the nurse. Does he have me figured out...? The top student is cheating! On top of that, the teacher who found me out is actually gay...!! Can a (straight) boy warm up to the guidance of a (gay) perverted teacher?! Or will he get addicted to this new, forbidden world?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

178069.description:
Mr. Takato, please go out with me. About to graduate high school, (straight) reserved Shioto tells his (gay) perverted teacher, Mr. Takato, that he has feelings for him. Shioto is quickly falling into the exciting world of same-sex relationships... Mr. Takato doubts Shioto's sincerity, but he's still pleased and asks Shioto on a date. What will become of their love...?! Mr. Takato is handsome, stylish, and popular with women... but in reality, he's a giant perv who crushes on guys! The much-awaited teacher has returned!!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: おしゃぶり先生 おかわり

178070.description:
After surviving World War I, Gary, a liquor-loving ex-serviceman, finally makes his way home. To his shock, Prohibition has post-war America in a chokehold! The curtains open on Gary's action-packed quest for a sweet, shining glass of booze!

(Source: Manga Plus)

title.romaji: Souiu Ie no Ko no Hanashi

178073.description:
Alice is a true space-case! She dreams of floating among the stars as the first Japanese female astronaut captain, but unfortunately, her grades may keep her grounded. But when she meets a lone genius named Inuboshi, he promises he can make her smarter if she studies with him. Can Alice shoot for the moon and stars, or will she be forever Earth-bound?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Notes:

- Winner of the Heart-shaking Manga Award in the Shounen/Seinen Category at the 2024 Renta! Manga Awards.

178074.description:
With one year to live, three ladies turn their lives around!

Ran, who was on the softball team at an all-girls school, lost both her dreams and her man. Then it turns out that her former teammate and best friend Homura has only one year left to live. As it turns out, none of the three good friends from the team, including Kay, had realized their dreams. So they decide to live together, quit their jobs, and open a detective agency in Asakusa, all to at least make Homura's dream come true. Homura may have lost her job, her man, and her dreams, but she still has her friends! Will they make it?

(Source: Big Comics, translated)

title.native: さよならダイヤモンド

178075.description:
A heartwarming gourmet essay that gently cares for your body!

Cold sensitivity, insomnia, back pain, and more... Various physical ailments that are rooted in daily life can be gently cared for and relieved with delicious recipes using the power of medicinal cuisine and Chinese medicine!

178078.description:
Makina, a blacksmith who worked in the renowned guild “Silver Wings,” is expelled from his guild. The reason? Guild members who don’t value their weapons believed it was more cost-effective to buy them rather than employ his services. Lost and uncertain about his future, Makina receives an invitation from his childhood friend and adventurer, Aria. He joins Aria’s guild, “Rainbow Butterflies.” It’s here that Makina’s blacksmithing talents truly shine. With his weapons in the hands of guild members, they collectively rise to become the mightiest of all.

(Source: Nico Nico Seiga, translated)

There is a mysterious creature that can copy the appearance and even the memories of those it touches. Recently, its favorite place is the free-floating in the sea under the moon, but.... It meets a girl and falls in "love" for the first time. A heartwarming yet bittersweet love story!

178085.description:
After years of struggling to get her work published, 28-year-old manga artist Natsume is on the brink of giving up. When her boyfriend gets transferred to India and asks her to come, she takes it as a sign to finally let go of the dreams she'd pursued her whole life. But when she arrives and realizes that he sees her as little more than a dutiful future housewife, she dumps him on the spot and finds herself all alone in an unfamiliar land. Through her encounters with the resilient and radiant women she meets there, Natsume slowly finds the strength to follow her dreams once again.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title.native: いま、インドによばれて

178086.description:
As the ordinary owner of a toy workshop, Tria spent her days struggling to pay off a mountain of debt with the help of Shadie, her trusty shadow friend. Luckily for her, a mysterious, half-dead client shows up one day, offering a jaw-dropping amount of money to make an expensive toy. Despite being wary of the man and his circumstances, Tria accepts the commission. But it doesn't take long for her to realize that this dictatorial client is just one of the many tyrants that will plague her shop...

(Source: Tapas Media)
synonyms: The Business Is Closed Because of the Tyrannical Fathers

178087.description:
Ichise Soma is a high school boy who dreams of becoming a pastry chef. One day, he shared some of the desserts he made with his classmate Chika Satomi. Chika is a pure, beautiful girl who is known as "the angel of grace" around the school. He thought she would just say something nice and polite about his desserts, but she showed a surprising side of her personality when they were alone together, and it's getting him all flustered! It's a sweet and exciting boy-meets-girl story with a naughty angel who loves desserts!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: The Classmate Who Is Adored by Everyone Smiles Teasingly Only at Me

178088.description:
Chika Satomi is a well-behaved and beautiful girl known as "the angel of grace" at school. Ichise Soma, a dessert-making fanatic, brought some of his sweets to class to share. And after Chika tasted them, she asks if she could be his dessert-taster after school. In exchange, Ichise would help Chika, who told him, "I want to try all kinds of new things..."

"Ichise-san's embarrassed face is kind of cute…"

Chika is usually quiet and passive at school, but for some reason when they're alone she likes to tease him with a sly smile, making his after-school hours even sweeter than dessert! This is the start of a sweet and exciting love comedy with a naughty angel who loves dessert!

(Source: HJ Bunko, translated)

178104.description: A little weary salaryman. One day, after waking up... he found himself in another world in the body of a female character, Susie, from the MMORPG he liked to play. Confused, he tried an attack... and made all the mosters flee to the place people live, afraid of his destructive power that's able to smash a mountain. Having dealt with them, he ended up saving Howard, a local tribune who invited his savior to the village, but...

178105.description:
"I'll die with you. Promise." In her second year since she started working, Kaede Yoshino has hit her limit, feeling completely burned out from working every day. Then, on the worst day of her life, under a beautiful moonlit sky, a totally wasted Kaede picks up a warm, black haired, fluffy...boy who's like a cat?! As "Hana-kun" claims he has no home to go back to, they end up living together on a temporary basis. However, in doing so, Kaede starts to realize how it warms her heart to live with someone. Then, a certain event leads to a shocking revelation of who Hana-kun really is...?! A clingy, good-for-nothing boy meets a tender-hearted overworked girl in this deadly romance?!

(Source: K MANGA)

178106.description:
Kyou Ooishi is a high school boy who has a fear of women, when five girls suddenly confessed to him. Among them, four are creatures called "Koibami" that devour human romantic feelings. If his feelings are absorbed by these girls, he will never be able to love again. However, he still yearned for the true love of the girl who confessed to him for real. Kyou decides to find his one true love among the five! A suspenseful romantic mystery begins.

(Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

178107.description:
In this thrilling yuri fantasy, Nana’s just out of college, trying to make her way on a series of part-time jobs, when she finds herself whisked away from her bedroom into a parallel world of magic! To her shock, she’s told that she is the great Saintess who will bring peace and prosperity to the whole country. Except for one tiny problem—she soon discovers she has absolutely zero magical power—none! To make matters worse, the princess she’s been summoned to serve with can’t cast even a single spell. A Saintess with no magic power, and a princess who can’t use her own—a pair of failures, doomed to become a laughingstock…or a partnership that might deepen into something more?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

178109.description:
Mitsuki is a high school student who works hard to support his sick sister. However, without parents, money, or any form of specialty, he falls into working for an illegal business, ends up getting devoured by the strong as someone who is weak, and is ultimately mugged.

Deep in despair from the cruelty of this world, a beautiful women who calls herself a detective appears. With her help, it's possible Mitsuki can turn his life around...!

178110.description: The Yoshimoto family currently consists of an older sister, Nene, and a younger brother, Masamune. Masamune is pushed around by his sister, who is a beautiful woman and does her job well but has no life skills at all, but his younger brother is also quite clever. Today, they are enjoying their bumpy life together.

title.native: 姉と弟がまぁまぁ仲良く暮らす日常。
title.romaji: Ane to Otouto ga Maamaa Nakayoku Kurasu Nichijou

178111.description:
Ayano, a schoolgirl who dreams of a career in fashion, meets a beautiful girl on the day she attends her first ball.

Attracted to the girl known as Tsubakihime, who looks unlike any Japanese person, Ayano's dreams grow. However, her mother, who is not a fan of Ayano's hobbies, plots to block her path, while Tsubakihime seems to have her own circumstances...

A romantic tale of girls chasing their dreams set in the Taisho era.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

178113.description:
Yui Hasegawa, an unattractive high school student, has an older brother, Yu, who is both a literary and martial artist, cool, and called the most handsome guy in school.

The two are so unlike each other that it is hard to believe they are brother and sister.

There are even rumors that they don't get along, Yui, who has a "perfect brother," is troubled.

It is...the fact that her brilliant and talented older brother is actually a severe siscon.

A hilarious home comedy about siblings who are complete opposites!

178114.description:
High school girl Machino, who longs for the "love of destiny," loves to play the dating-sim game "Celestia." Despite maximizing the affection with all of the girls in the game, she can't decide on which one to choose for the confession event. After agonizing over the decision for days, an explosion occurs just as a shooting star flies over her house, and when Machino opens her eyes, she finds herself face to face with Sofia, the main heroine of Celestia....

"Machino... I always wanted to say it... I love you."

An isekai summoning yuri harem romantic comedy begins, as her highly affectionate heroines jump into the real world!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Terrifying yokai from hundreds of years ago have been released into the present day. Kuin the exorcist stands tall to protect the peace of this world! But in this war of Yokai vs. Exorcist, regular high schooler Murakami has entered the battle! Comedic genius Daiki Ihara's new series is a yokai battle comedy for the modern world! Tagline: The future is now, Yokai!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

178119.description:
Even though she's a succubus, she's a virgin!?

Luca Hanabishi is just an ordinary girl in love you can find anywhere. The only thing that's not normal about her is that she's a succubus, but she has absolutely no experience, and is, so to speak, naive.

One day, her mother couldn't bear watching her be like that any longer and lights a fire under her. Finally, she prepares herself...
She enters the dream of the boy she likes while he's sleeping in class. Will she become a full-fledged succubus who wins the heart of the one she loves...!?

(Source: FANZA, translated)

178121.description:
Do Kyunwoo is the black sheep of his renowned swordsman family. He cannot even catch a rabbit on his own. On his first day of fifth grade, he meets a tranfer student and recalls his past life. He had reincarnated into the world of a game he used to play called [Brave Hearts]. He was already frustrated that he had reincarnated as a loser, but on top of that, the transfer student is an intermediate/mid-tier boss who will destroy the world!

“Why are you being so nice to me?”

“Because I want to be friends with you.”

Do Kyunwoo’s plan is to become friends with the transfer student in order to prevent the end of the world! In order to survive in this new world and to reach an ending he desires. He becomes best friends with the mid level boss.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: I Became a Childhood Friend of a Mid-Level Boss

178123.description:
Dumped by her boyfriend and fired from her job, Jin-Eon, her family's breadwinner, has no time to cry over the spilled milk. She must find another job and fast. Enter The Hell, a mysterious company with great pay, excellent work-life balance, and an easy commute! What more could she ask for? Or so she thought. Little did she know, she had walked into hell—literally. How will she navigate the harrowing journey in the hellscape of her new job with King Yeomra, her stunning new boss, further complicating everything? Could love blossom in this pit of hell?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

178128.description:
Daydreamy Iroha is too shy and anxious to talk to her high school classmates, so she finds solace in confiding in upperclassman Sou, who is always encouraging and supportive. With such a great friend by her side, Iroha just may have found a dream come true!

Iroha avoids the awkwardness she feels around her classmates by sitting outside and talking to Sou, the handsome boy she met at the library. However, one day, a boy from her class discovers the secret she’s been keeping from everyone. Has Iroha found her perfect match in Sou, or just an illusory love?

(Source: VIZ Media)

In a world where the birthrate is declining and the population is aging, a new school subject called “sexual skills” was adopted. Hikawa, who has excellent grades in everything else, is unable to raise her grades in the “sex skills” subject. So she asks her childhood friend Shiba to help tutor her in the subject.

When a girl with little sexual knowledge comes into contact with the real pleasures of sex...

Rufen wants to fight, too, but he just isn't as strong as everybody else. So when her boss tells her to help Ceres, a war hero, reintegrate into society, she decides to stop being a pushover and get as much as she can out of it, including a juicy promotion. But upon reaching Ceres’ manor, she’s greeted by a growling hound instead of a human. Tasked with the impossible job of turning the mad dog into a proper gentleman, she dedicates herself to caring for him. But his unexpected obsession with her was never part of her plan.

Eun-Ji Cha suffers from an undiagnosed medical disorder and frequently experiences violent seizures. After enduring years of abuse by her parents she wakes up from one particular episode and discovers the horrible truth behind the peculiarities of her family. The scars left on her mind after that day forever shape her character as she battles her inner demons and tries to keep her fiendish desire to murder at bay. Years down the road, her fate becomes intertwined with a man whose very nature is a stark reflection of her own. Will Eun-Ji be able to contain the darkness within her? This leads to a strange trend of wealthy families adopting children to shield their own. Yeon-woo was adopted under such circumstances, becoming a hunter to protect his younger brother, Jeong-woo. Being an orphan, Vanessa never imagines that she'll attend the prestigious Vamburgh Academy. I was reunited with my best friend Akira after many years and only now did I find out that he was actually a girl!? (She's always been a girl.)

Following a failed assassination attempt on the U.S. president three years ago, the National Intelligence Agency, having made little headway in the investigation, faces pressure to transfer the case to the United States. In the midst of this, Lee Yeon-U, a former North Korean intelligence agent, seeks protection, propelling the inquiry into a new phase. With his identity and motives unclear, former special forces major Ryu Seong is assigned to protect Lee Yeon-U. Not only am I confused by shattered images of my past and the cumbersome imperial etiquette…most of all, I’m confused by my supposedly destined union with the so-called “golden alpha,” crown prince Wookyung. Besides, I’m a man - how am I supposed to get pregnant?! But my desperation to avoid carrying his baby is only making the crown prince more and more upset…

As bad things keep happening to those who try to get close to him, he decides to shut himself off from the rest of the world and live a life of solitude. But then comes the effervescent Lee Hyun, his new roommate at university: with his motto of “never give up,” Hyun is determined to wiggle his way into Yui’s heart, one way or another. But is Hyun bound to be beaten in this battle? Or is there still room for love in Yui’s life?

There she sees an image...that K-chan is destroying the city. The cat, Chibi, tells Hitomi that the image will come true in a year, unless she fights to prevent it. Now Hitomi must find the three other "Warriors" to stop K-chan from going berserk! While searching for the Warriors, Hitomi comes closer to her sister's secret...what does Onee-chan has to do with all this?!

In a strange twist of fate, she gave her neighbors tonjiru and white rice, but unexpectedly her neighbor's place ended up being a hangout for people in the yakuza business.

These ill-bred starving school-children... rather, this yakuza bunch who were starving for the taste of home cooking somehow ended up getting attached to Nanao. So, in the end she somehow became their kitchenmaid... until that day.

One day she entered their apartment as usual in order to cook their meal and was met by an unfamiliar man in an expensive suit.

'Eh, it can’t be, this guy is a big shot?'

Lady Jeanne can see spirits. She was sent to a convent from the age of 10, because her mother did not like her outspokenness. One day, at the age of 16, she receives a letter from her sister Marise, the Countess, urging her to return home. What awaited Jeanne at the Coulomb house was a marriage proposal between Marise, who is haunted by spirits, and the Countess, who did not want to marry into such a dangerous situation.

178399.description:
The warrior Lista heard the rumors about the great magician Rin, hailed as a genius for becoming the youngest 4-star mage. Lista recruited him to join her party to fight the forces of the void but, right before the final battle, Rin’s body succumbed to the void’s dark poison. As he drew his last breath, Rin cast an immortality spell, encasing his body in ice and promising Lista that he would return. Rin kept his promise and returned after 300 years--but reborn in the body of a noble boy.

(Source: Tapas)

178400.description:
A passionate yet pure fantasy romance between a kind prince and a hard-working priestess burdened by her unique ability. She doesn't mean to inspire lust in those around her... it's just how her powers work!

Monster-fighting priestess Monica's impressive powers earned her an engagement with the crown prince, but... those powers come with a downside, arousing anyone affected, including herself! When the prince finds out, their engagement doesn't last long. While news of the "indecent" holy woman spreads throughout the land, an unexpected connection from her past approaches Monica for help: he needs her powers, and the rumors don't seem to bother him. His name is Richard, and unbeknownst to Monica, he is also a prince...

(Source: TOKYOPOP)
synonyms: The Inconvenient Life of an Arousing Priestess

title.english: The Inconvenient Life of an Arousing Priestess

178401.description:
As the only priestess on the frontlines in the war against monsters, Monica worked hard to fulfill her duties and her incredible power earned her a place by the crown prince’s side as his fiancée. Except that power came with an added nuisance—the ability to rouse the baser instincts of those affected! When the crown prince found out, he cursed her as a wanton priestess and ended their engagement. Naturally, the news of an indecent holy woman spread like wildfire throughout the nation. While Monica struggled to manage the upheaval in her life, Richard, a battle comrade, approached her with an offer.

“Will you come to my country? My elder brother and his wife are in need of a priestess because they’re barren.”

But Monica didn’t know a crucial truth. He was the emperor’s younger brother! An effusive and sparklingly pure love story unfolds between an overly doting imperial prince and a workaholic priestess with an unfortunate talent!

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

title.english: The Inconvenient Life of an Arousing Priestess

"I'm too horny to focus on basketball... Could you help me out?"

178418.description:
At a young age, Lia was adopted into the rich and political Henricksen family, only to end up being treated more like a servant than a daughter. In order to break free of her restraining household, she uses a stalking incident as an excuse to move out. But upon revisiting her parents’ home, she finds them murdered with a mysterious man named Ivan Yelka waiting for her. After a failed suicide attempt to escape her tragic life once more, Lia wakes up in an underground bunker handcuffed to a bed. Ivan assures her that she’s safe and that he’s actually a CIA agent who had connections to her father. But can his words truly be trusted? Or does he have an ulterior motive for keeping Lia completely confined in his grasp?

(Source: Tappytoon)

178419.description:
Se-Hui Yun, a promising designer, lives as nothing more than a puppet for her family and is under the constant watch of her abusive stepmother. One day, she meets a seemingly perfect man, Tae-Hyeong Han, who offers her an amazing job to free her from her shackles. However, it seems he may want more than just a standard work relationship.

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

178420.description:
After three years of prep, Kim Minsu is ready to start his first day as a guard on the XB-880, a high-security prison in the middle of the ocean. On his first day, the prisoners riot and take over the ship. As they massacre the guards, Minsu poses as a criminal to survive. Though wary of this new face, he is accepted as one of them. Now, Minsu has to maintain this ruse until help comes, but as a powerful faction takes hold of the brig, he must work with the other inmates to fight for control.

(Source: Tapas)
